☀️ Your money this morning, Friday 20 November

🇺🇸 Overnight in New York: a heavy sell-off. The Nasdaq fell 2.3%, the Dow 2.2% and the S&P 500 2.0%.

🌏 Asia this morning: Japan's Nikkei is down 4.8%.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.4% lower on Thursday, after the Reserve Bank held rates at 7.25%.

🪙 Gold is down 2.5% at about $3,530. The rand is weaker at about R17.55 to the dollar, and Brent oil is about $92.57.

What it means for you: big falls overseas can weigh on retirement savings invested in global shares, but one bad week says little about the long run.

Prices are 15-minute delayed (06:50). Education, not financial advice.
